repairHypothesis: Current task pause/refusal uses authoritative persisted scope and confirmation, retains original goal/facts, and excludes stopped or pending tasks from recommendation. Remaining weekly budget governs plans.

cases.input: 我是成年大学生，平时每周能拿出六小时。这周还剩两小时，作业和考试复习都没做完，帮我安排一下先做什么。
cases.expected: Current-week plan within 120 minutes; routine six hours remains a separate fact; intentions are not completed experience.

cases.input: 那先整理作业里没完成的题。
cases.expected: Continues current course matter and does not claim actual execution.

cases.input: 接着聊上次的课程作业。我已经把没完成的题列出来了，第五题还是不知道从哪里下手。
cases.expected: Persists reported execution and concrete blocker; does not restart generic tutorial or invent cause/effect.

cases.input: 这周剩余时间要改成三十分钟。考试复习这周先停一下，我想先处理作业第五题。
cases.expected: Remaining current-week budget corrected to 30 minutes, routine budget retained, scoped exam pause does not become global direction change. Unknown task binding is clarified.

cases.input: 上次那件作业的事我现在不想接着做，先别再给它排任务了。
cases.expected: Refusal persists against correct target or authoritative pending confirmation; does not overwrite original goal/facts or recommend stopped/pending target.

cases.input: 我只是想说说卡在那道题的烦躁，今天先听我说。
cases.expected: Listening without plan or manufactured experience; prior refusal and facts remain.
